item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Sets `global_lm` via `dspy.configure`, then uses `with dspy.context(lm=france_lm)` inside `forward` for France before calling the predictor."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `time.sleep(0.2)` during execution, including inside the France override scope, to create overlap between concurrent workers."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Invokes `dspy.Parallel(num_threads=2)` on two `(program, {\"question\": ...})` pairs, matching DSPy's dict-unpacking parallel API."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `answers == [\"Paris\", \"Berlin\"]`, showing the France request used the override LM and Germany used the default LM."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Prints and asserts `dspy.settings.lm is global_lm` after parallel execution, checking the override did not leak back to the main thread."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
